The '''Slession system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the conflict known as the [[Sundering of Slession]],<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> which was fought at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' is presented as an [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|in-universe document]] published nineteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. The [[in-universe]] ''Imperial Handbook'' mentions Imperial involvement in the [[Sundering of Slession]]. Therefore, the conflict must have been fought at some point between the formation of the Empire, dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''The New Essential Chronology'', and 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Slession [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
